speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. To narrow down the cause, can you describe the nature of the flank pain—is it sharp or dull, and is it on one side or both?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, or notice any blood in your urine? Have you experienced any nausea or vomiting along with these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any abdominal pain, joint pain, or swelling in your legs while you were taking the cephalexin? I need to determine if this is an allergic reaction or a kidney issue.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
Do you have any history of kidney stones or previous kidney infections?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. Complete_Blood_Count: NORMAL READINGS
